messages:
Asha (marketing): quick ask — we need a small sanity probe of the bench numbers for the webinar/press deck. timeline: live talk in 4 days. Can runtime run a minimal, reproducible sweep we can cite (latency percentiles + cost/unit) and hand us raw artifacts?
Miguel (eng-runtime): can do. clarify: which model variants (FP16 / 4-bit quant / 8-bit) and exact slice of traffic you want?
Asha (marketing): primary callouts are quantized vs baseline FP16 across two cohort sizes: 1) demo payload (short: ~64 tokens) 2) long-context example (~2048). Also need cold start vs warmed percentiles. Keep sample sizes small but representative — aim for ~100 profiles per slice.
Riley (eng-runtime): ok — we can run FP16, int8 quant, and q4_0. Warmup policy: do you want a 0-seconds cold run + 30s warmed window, or a standardized 5-request warmup?
Jordan (product-marketing): standardize on 5-request warmup for comparability with other slides. Also include 95p and 99p latency and tokens/sec.
Miguel (eng-runtime): noted. two more things: seed for RNG and commit hash of the model/runtime so results are reproducible — what should we pin?
Ben (data-science): for sample selection I can provide a 100-case seed list derived from our demo cohort. seed=42 is fine for deterministic selection, but note it biases toward earlier traffic.
Asha (marketing): use seed=42 and attach the sample list. For commit hash, pin to the staging runtime SHA: use latest-staging if that's easiest but record the exact SHA in artifacts.
Riley (eng-runtime): good. we'll run:```
bench-sweep --model redwood-1.5b --variants fp16,int8,q4_0 --cohorts demo_short,demo_long --samples 100 --warmup 5 --seed 42 --trace=true --output artifact.tar.gz
```
Riley (eng-runtime): ETA is ~6h for a single parallel sweep on staging GPUs. if you need multiple repeats (to show variance), say how many repeats.
Asha (marketing): do one full sweep + one repeat for each quantized variant (so FP16 x1, int8 x2, q4_0 x2). That should be enough to show stability. Also we need a short methodology blurb we can copy into the deck (2-3 sentences) describing warmup and sample provenance.
Miguel (eng-runtime): will produce artifacts: raw traces, latency histograms, config JSON (includes seed, commit, env), and a short README with commands run. We'll include a small CSV summary with p50/p95/p99 and cost/unit.
deploy-bot: Deploy to staging cluster succeeded (deploy/1234) — runtime pods at 3/3 ready.
Ben (data-science): I'll hand over the 100-case sample list in this thread in ~30m. Also will run a quick check to ensure no extreme outliers (spammy payloads).
Jordan (product-marketing): thanks — will draft the 2-sentence methodology blurb once you post the README. We want something like: "Benchmarks were run on staging hardware using a fixed 5-request warmup and deterministic sample selection (seed=42). Reported percentiles reflect median of repeated sweeps and include both cold-start and warmed windows." Is that okay?
Miguel (eng-runtime): that's accurate. we'll also note quantization configs and any scheduler differences.
Asha (marketing): perfect. please @thread when artifacts are uploaded to the shared bucket. If anything blocks the 6h ETA call it out here. :pray:
Riley (eng-runtime): starting runs now. will post artifact link + SHA when done.
Asha (marketing): thank you!
